name: feedback
description: One promise, due on day 1 at noon: the stub's intention turn writes the cat meme as plain text outside any call (it reaches nobody) and marks the intention done. The scheduler queues one feedback wake in the same chain for the next tick, naming the dropped line and the intention closed without delivery; the stub then posts through message.create. The feedback turn gets no feedback of its own.
